## Key Engineering & Design Specializations
- **AOSP & Android Kernel Engineering**: Compiling, tuning, and optimizing custom Android kernels, Energy Aware Scheduler (EAS), CPU governor tables, zram controllers, and hardware abstraction layer (HAL) integrations.
- **Cinematic UI/UX & Web Development**: High-performance full-stack web applications using Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and GSAP micro-animations.
- **Native Mobile Development**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, SQLite Room database architecture, offline-first architectures.
- **Design Systems**: Typography engineering, layout math, fluid viewport scaling, dark mode tokens, and accessible interfaces.

## Selected Works & Projects
- **Titan**: High-performance Progressive Web App (PWA) built with Next.js, complex caching strategies, and atomic database transactions (https://github.com/rayyan-x95/Titan).
- **EduCard**: Smart student identification and tracking ecosystem with encrypted credentials (https://github.com/rayyan-x95/EduCard).
- **Habitate**: Offline-first Android habit tracker built natively with Jetpack Compose and Room DB (https://github.com/rayyan-x95/Habitate).
- **Ninety5 Studio**: Creative digital product and systems design agency (https://www.ninety5.in).
